clips.title: The story
paras: Brewmeister Bilger waits in Southshore's inn cellar for deliveries from distant lands. The intoxicated dwarf passes his hours tasting potent spirits.
Brewmeister Bilger paces the cellar beneath Southshore's inn, nursing hiccups as he seeks the strongest brews Azeroth can offer.

Brewmeister Bilger can judge spirits despite his constant stupor. He favors heavy dwarven moonshines and potent southern liquors, and eagerly receives special batches such as the moonshine Foggy MacKreel sends from the Thandol Span.
